items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: My big thing on the road was with Maynard’s band.

ctx.x: When you were young were you one of those, let’s say when you were a teenager, did you have a choice in your career or were you compelled to just go into music?

I was compelled, not through my parents, but self-compelled. And I realized very young that I really wanted to be in music. And my whole family was basically in music. My father was very good, like a Freddie Green kind of guitar player. He had a big band, and his brothers all played. It was the Italian end so they were all barbers and string player or accordion.
